name: @ahr/ai
description: Minimal AI Assistance (Packages Specification Package 06; 14-AI-Integration.md). Archive-scoped, human-reviewed-only AI suggestions for Category/Tag assignment and draft summary/description text on Work/Project entities. OpenAI only, behind a provider-agnostic aiClient abstraction. No autonomous write to any governed platform state; every output is ephemeral in v1 (no ai_recommendation_log table exists yet — see docs/blocked-persistence.md). Built during the Development Audit (Development track) — the package did not exist before; nothing here changes the frozen schema, the Permissions Matrix, or any prior architecture decision.
